name: Emrys
source:
LIKES: Cooking
DISLIKES: Clothing

A mysterious resident of the Inn, not much is known about him.

The ears and tail of a cat he's a troublesome shapeshifter who seems to belong to the inn.

He's an aloof flirt but will do absolutely anything to protect Myka.
